programme.title: South Park: Tout sur les Mormons
programme.desc: Un enfant mormon arrive dans la classe des garçons. Stan est supposé lui casser la figure, mais son père et lui sont soudain fascinés par la religion des nouveaux venus, et leur extrême gentillesse. Stan ne tardera pas à revenir sur son avis.

programme.title: South Park: Stop clopes
programme.desc: Les garçons sont surpris en train de fumer après avoir vu un spectacle ringard contre la cigarette. Rob Reiner, militant extrémiste anti-tabac, décide de piéger les fabricants de cigarettes avec l'aide des garçons.

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Stan déprime quand Wendy le plaque. Ses amis l'emmènent alors au 'Raisins', réputé pour ses hôtesses de bar sexy. Butters tombe amoureux de l'une d'entre elles, et Stan décide de devenir gothique.

programme.title: South Park: Noël au Canada
programme.desc: Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les armes, c'est rigolo
programme.desc: Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: South Park: Génial-O
programme.desc: Cartman s'habille comme un robot, s'auto-proclame 'Génial-O' et déménage chez Butters pour découvrir tous ses secrets et les utiliser contre lui.

programme.title: South Park: Les stéroïdes ça déchire
programme.desc: Jimmy s'entraîne pour un événement sportif imminent et est déterminé à gagner à n'importe quel prix. Cartman décide qu'il peut facilement remporter la première place contre Jimmy.

programme.title: South Park: La passion du juif
programme.desc: Cartman a vu le film « La Passion du Christ ». Depuis, il est fan de Mel Gibson et de son film. Il veut alors monter un fan-club très spécial.

programme.title: South Park: Les Gluants
programme.desc: Des humains de l'an 4035 débarquent à South Park à travers un portail temporel et recherchent du travail.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jefferson
programme.desc: Une nouvelle famille arrive à South Park : les Jefferson. Monsieur Jefferson accueille les enfants de South Park chez lui pour les faire jouer dans son parc personnel.

programme.title: South Park: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca
programme.desc: La SPA manifeste contre l'utilisation d'une vache comme mascotte de l'école élémentaire de South Park. Les écoliers sont obligés d'en choisir une autre.
programme.sub-title: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca

programme.title: South Park: Le Supermarché des Ténèbres
programme.desc: La rue principale de South Park se transforme en ville fantôme quand un supermarché géant Wall Mart attire les citadins jusqu'à son tout nouveau magasin aux affaires incroyables.

programme.title: South Park: Maternelle
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que Trent Boyett est en prison. Celui-ci y est incarcéré, à la place des garçons, pour avoir brûlé leur professeur de maternelle. Quand il sort de prison, les enfants paniquent alors à l'idée de sa vengeance.

programme.title: South Park: Course à l'audience
programme.desc: Les garçons de South Park produisent leur propre journal d'informations du matin sur la station de télévision de l'école, et sont immédiatement entraînés dans une intense course à l'audience.

programme.title: South Park: Kit vidéo pour stupide pute trop gâtée
programme.desc: Paris Hilton ouvre une boutique en ville, dans laquelle toutes les petites filles pourront acheter de quoi se transformer en parfaite peste. Son chien s'étant suicidé, Paris veut acheter Butters pour le remplacer.
programme.sub-title: Kit vidéo pour stupide pute trop gâtée

programme.title: South Park: Le don incroyable de Cartman
programme.desc: Après avoir reçu une sévère blessure à la tête, Cartman se voit doté de dons de voyance.

programme.title: South Park: Le Noël des petits animaux de la forêt
programme.desc: Stan est sollicité par un groupe d'adorables animaux de la forêt pour les aider à construire une crèche pour la naissance de leur Seigneur et sauveur. Il accepte, mais découvre qu'ils servent en fait Satan.
programme.sub-title: Le Noël des petits animaux de la forêt

programme.title: South Park: Le Vagin tout neuf de M. Garrison
programme.desc: Monsieur Garrison subit une opération de changement de sexe, mais il se rend compte qu'il ne pourra jamais connaître les plaisirs d'avoir ses règles ou l'avortement.
programme.sub-title: Le Vagin tout neuf de M. Garrison

programme.title: South Park: Crève hippie, crève
programme.desc: La ville de South Park est envahie par les hippies qui veulent faire un festival. Leur ennemi juré, Cartman, compte bien les arrêter.

programme.title: South Park: Wing
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman et Kenny décident de devenir imprésarios. Après l'échec de leur travail avec Token, on leur confie Wing, la femme du gérant de City Wok.

programme.title: South Park: Potes pour la vie
programme.desc: Kenny obtient une PSP, mais il meurt. En réalité, Dieu l'a choisi pour mener une lutte salutaire au paradis. Malheureusement, les docteurs réaniment Kenny, qui se retrouve dans un état végétatif.

programme.title: South Park: La fureur de perdre
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park sont désespérés : leurs parents veulent absolument qu'ils jouent au baseball mais eux s'ennuient terriblement. Tout empire lorsqu'ils apprennent qu'un match de qualification les obligerait à jouer tout l'été.

programme.title: South Park: La Mort d'Eric Cartman
programme.desc: Les enfants se mettent d'accord pour ignorer Cartman, et ce dernier croit qu'il est mort. Butters, qui n'est pas au courant de la supercherie, devient le médium de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Le jour des érections
programme.desc: Jimmy a des problèmes d'érections impromptues. Étant donné qu'il doit participer au concours de talents, il cherche de l'aide pour résoudre ce problème.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Butters maquille sa mort pour que les garçons puissent récupérer un appareil à faire des prédictions.

programme.title: South Park: Suivez cet œuf
programme.desc: Madame Garrison a encore des sentiments pour Monsieur Esclave, mais en allant le voir elle s'aperçoit qu'il est avec Al Super Gay et qu'ils comptent se marier.

programme.title: South Park: Les Rouquins
programme.desc: Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park: Piégé dans le placard
programme.desc: Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: South Park: Sauvez Wilzy-X
programme.desc: Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park: Le Retour de Chef
programme.desc: Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Danger Snobfog
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park: Un million de petites fibres
programme.desc: Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park: Homoursporc
programme.desc: Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir
programme.desc: Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.
programme.sub-title: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kuma is ordered by the World Government to obliterate every living being on the island, but the Straw Hats – battered as they may be – refuse to go down without a fight!
programme.sub-title: IT REPELS EVERYTHING / KUMA'S PAW-PAW POWER

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A heated confrontation occurs between Zoro and Sanji as they argue over who will sacrifice themselves to save Luffy, but Kuma's final attack may be worse than death.
programme.sub-title: THE PAIN OF MY CREWMATES IS MY PAIN / ZORO'S DESPERATE FIGHT

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji learns the truth about Zoro's amazing sacrifice, and Brook is overjoyed to learn that Laboon is still alive and doing fine!
programme.sub-title: THE PROMISE FROM A DISTANT DAY / THE PIRATES' SONG AND A SMALL WHALE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A flashback reveals the story of how Laboon and Brook became friends – and the promise that was made at the hour of their sorrowful parting of the ways.
programme.sub-title: BROOK'S PAST / A SAD FAREWELL WITH HIS CHEERFUL COMRADE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook remembers the painful loss of his beloved captain, the tragic end to his musical pirate crew, and his lonely days as a skeleton adrift in the shadows.
programme.sub-title: BINK'S BREW / THE SONG THAT CONNECTS THE PAST WITH THE PRESENT

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook officially signs on as the newest member of the Straw Hats, and Luffy learns that his brother Ace may be in some serious trouble.
programme.sub-title: A NEW CREWMATE! THE MUSICIAN, HUMMING BROOK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats encounter two young girls who are looking for their father, and Luffy has another run in with the devious Captain Foxy!
programme.sub-title: THE SLOW-SLOW MENACE / "SILVER FOX" FOXY RETURNS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook struggles to adjust to life among living after so many years alone in the darkness. Can the Straw Hats survive his chaotic attempts to fit in?
programme.sub-title: BROOK'S GREAT STRUGGLE / IS THE PATH TO BECOMING A TRUE COMRADE RIGOROUS?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After surviving a terrible storm to reach the entrance to the Red Line, Luffy slugs a mysterious sea monster and Sanji may finally get to meet a mermaid!
programme.sub-title: HALFWAY ACROSS THE GRAND LINE / ARRIVAL AT THE RED LINE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats agree to help a mermaid rescue her friend, but the mission gets dangerous when a gang of flying fish dive bomb their boat!
programme.sub-title: HE HATES THE STRAW HAT CREW / IRON MASKED DUVAL MAKES HIS APPEARANCE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats agree to join Camie's rescue mission, but her captured friend turns out to be a dangerous enemy from the past!
programme.sub-title: THE FATED REUNION! SAVE THE CAPTIVE FISHMAN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats wage a death-defying battle with a group of flying fish, and Luffy is shocked by the familiar face of their latest enemy!
programme.sub-title: TRAGEDY! THE TRUTH HIDDEN UNDER DUVAL'S MASK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji squares off against his lookalike, Camie shows off just how fast a mermaid can swim, and Luffy defeats a giant bull without even landing a blow!
programme.sub-title: EXPLOSION! SUNNY'S SUPER-SECRET WEAPON, GAON CANNON

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After their showdown with Duval, Luffy and the Straw Hats enjoy a hearty meal before proceeding to the site of their next adventure – an island bursting with bubbles!
programme.sub-title: DISEMBARKING WITH SIGHTS SET ON FISH-MAN ISLAND / THE SABAODY ARCHIPELAGO

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel, but it's not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.
programme.sub-title: TYRANNY! THE RULERS OF SABAODY, THE CELESTIAL DRAGONS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line's most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy's crew!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.
programme.sub-title: THE TARGET IS CAMIE!! THE LOOMING CLUTCHES OF A PROFESSIONAL KIDNAPPER

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they'll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!
programme.sub-title: RESCUE CAMIE / THE ARCHIPELAGO'S LINGERING DARK HISTORY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami's concocted a very generous plan!
programme.sub-title: TIME LIMIT / THE HUMAN AUCTION BEGINS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami's plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed Celestial Dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.
programme.sub-title: THE FIST EXPLODES! DESTROY THE AUCTION

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a Celestial Dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!
programme.sub-title: MAJOR PANIC! DESPERATE STRUGGLE AT THE AUCTION HOUSE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: They saved Camie from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass "Captain" Kidd and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!
programme.sub-title: ADMIRAL KIZARU TAKES ACTION! SABAODY ARCHIPELAGO THROWN INTO CHAOS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats join forces with Kidd's crew and Trafalgar's mates to make short work of the marines, but they're in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!
programme.sub-title: BREAK THROUGH THE SIEGE! THE NAVY VS. THE THREE CAPTAINS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh's house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger's ship.
programme.sub-title: ROGER AND RAYLEIGH - THE KING OF THE PIRATES AND HIS RIGHT HAND MAN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!
programme.sub-title: NO ESCAPE!? ADMIRAL KIZARU'S LIGHT SPEED KICK!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a Warlord lookalike.
programme.sub-title: OVERWHELMING! THE NAVY'S FIGHTING WEAPONS, THE PACIFISTAS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far deadlier foe comes looking for a fight.
programme.sub-title: AN EVEN STRONGER ENEMY APPEARS! THE BATTLE AXE-CARRYING SENTOMARU

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro's barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
programme.sub-title: ADMIRAL KIZARU'S FIERCE ASSAULT / THE STRAW HATS FACE CERTAIN DEATH!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
programme.sub-title: ELIMINATED FRIENDS - THE FINAL DAY OF THE STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a Warlord of the Sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
programme.sub-title: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / BOSS LUFFY APPEARS AGAIN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
programme.sub-title: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / DEFEAT THRILLER COMPANY'S TRAP!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man's amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
programme.sub-title: LANDING! THE ALL-FEMALE ISLAND, AMAZON LILY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An army of scantily-clad women warriors want to investigate Luffy's family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
programme.sub-title: HURRY BACK TO YOUR FRIENDS! THE MAIDEN ISLAND ADVENTURE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The women chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she's about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
programme.sub-title: EVERYONE FALLS IN LOVE! PIRATE EMPRESS HANCOCK

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Grandma's House: Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Surprise: It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Sticky Tape: Benny the Bull needs some Sticky Tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking, and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bouncing Ball: Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack: Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the Library. Can they reach the Library before it closes?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bugga Bugga: Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water: Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Star: Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Prince: Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken: Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off on an educational adventure to meet him.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Louder!: What are we going to do? Cockledoodledoo! Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun. Along the way we practice making lots of noise.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Roberto The Robot: Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies." A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Earth's Last Stand: As the team finally reaches Earth, Fugitoid reveals a horrible secret about his past.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War: When April graduates to full Kunoichi, she faces a deadly new enemy, while the Turtles face the return of some old, dangerous foes…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Broken Foot: When Leonardo secretly allies himself with Karai, he gets himself into deeper danger than he could have realized…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.desc: Ben Matlock’s nephew, Dr. Irwin Bruckner, is accused of murdering his boss, the director of a top-security think tank, and Matlock’s defense seems doomed to failure unless a master computer can be outsmarted.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock discovers he has more than one tricky suspect to contend with as he tries to defend magician Daniel Fontaine who’s accused of murdering Sandy Farrell, his ambitious and unfaithful assistant.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock takes on the defense of Nguyen Tran, a Vietnamese fisherman accused of murdering the town bully, a man who had been terrorizing Tran and his fellow countrymen.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Matlock’s murder defense of Allison Tate, a young heiress with a history of mental instability, is complicated by Warren Kreitzer, a New York lawyer who is responsible for her trust fund.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: When Matlock’s neighbor, Les Calhoun, returns a malfunctioning used car he just bought, he becomes the prime suspect in the saleman's murder. Although circumstantial evidence points to a conviction, Matlock sets out to prove his new neighbor was framed.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: When a British ambassador is accused by his lover, Shelby, of killing her husband, he refuses to hide behind diplomatic immunity and instead calls on Matlock to clear his name.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill Matlock and the British ambassador he’s defending of murder, Matlock realizes that finding his client’s vanished lover and accuser, Shelby, is the key to identifying the real killer.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: From an ancient submerged city a beautiful girl issues a warning about the devastating power - and danger - of three special, combining minicons. The Autobots already have two of them: now Megatron aims to capture the third.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The children learn more about the history of the minicons and the war. The latest minicon alert leads the team to a volcanic island: the volcano erupts in the middle of the usual 'Bot vs 'Con battle.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: he Decepticons gain access to the Autobot base, and attempt to take the other two minicons that, with the one Megatron captured on the island, combine to make the supremely powerful Star Sabre. Can Hot Shot save the day?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot proves himself very skilled with the Star Sabre, but the arrival of a new Decepticon proves him overconfident. The Decepticons acquire the first of another three combining minicons which transform into the ultimate form of defence.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new minicon activates inside a highway tunnel, and the race is on to see who reach it first. Hot Shot is becoming more proficient with the Star Sabre. A new transformer arrives, claiming to be an Autobot, but Rad has his doubts.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Grabbing onto Megatron at the end of a battle, Hot Shot and Sideways are transported to the moon. The battle resumes, but Hot Shot is betrayed, and Starscream gains the Star Sabre.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the loss of the Star Sabre, the Autobots keep losing battles. In a fog-bound valley, Megatron plots to get the Sabre from Starscream, at the same time boosting his crew's confidence in himself. Scavenger's secret is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Autobots and Decepticons face off amongst snowy mountains in the battle for the latest minicon. Despite using the Star Sabre, this time Megatron loses - and Scavenger finally gains the Autobots' trust.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A weekend's camping trip to the valley below the dam goes wrong when a violent storm moves in. With Red Alert trapped in a mudslide, the sluice gates about to open, and local reporter Kelly filming, how will the Autobots escape detection?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Autobot Blurr joins the team, but proves himself not much of a team player. The Decepticons acquire the final minicon to create the Skyboom Shield, the most powerful defensive weapon in the universe.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Confident of his ability to finally overcome the Autobots, Megatron challenges Optimus to battle. However, when all seems lost Optimus' minicon summons the Skyboom Shield to protect his master.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron's plan to split up the Autobot team and defeat them individually fails when it's revealed that the minicons have their own, secret agenda.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Decepticons lose another battle: Megatron takes out his frustration on Starscream, beating him half to death for no reason. Sideways uses the situation to try to foment unrest and rebellion.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Trapped in cyberspace with Sideways, Alexis, Rad, Carlos and their minicons become aware of a massive evil entity, far more powerful and dangerous than Megatron, lurking threateningly in the background. Or was it all a dream?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new transformer enters the solar system. On the moon, Thrust the master tactician arrives to assist Megatron in his battle against the Autobots, but all does not go according to plan.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Optimus damaged and temporarily out of commission, the newly-arrived Jetfire takes command - and seriously underestimates the Decepticons. But on the verge of defeat, Optimus reveals a new ability.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: On the moon, Thrust continues his plotting with Megatron. On earth, despite Jetfire saying he's one of the good guys, the kids are suspicious of Sideways - as are the Decepticons. And something huge and ominous is approaching earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The massive Tidalwave joins the Decepticons, but is, seemingly, defeated in battle by Hot Shot and Blurr. Alexis discovers three new minicons, which Sideways says combine to create another ultimate weapon, the Requiem Blaster.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The kids try to gather the three Requiem Blaster minicons together. Sky Blast at first resists, then sings the others to him to save Optimus. They all realise there's more to the minicons than first appears.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Understanding that the minicons want to be in charge of their own destinies, the kids sneak the new team out of the base. Thrust finds them, but so do the Autobots who save the day. It's agreed the minicons should not be forced to fight.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Enthusiastic young Sideswipe, Blurr's hero-worshipper, joins the team and Optimus tasks Hot Shot with training him. Wheeljack also arrives on earth, bent on revenge for Hot Shot seemingly abandoning him during a battle on Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Desperate to make amends to his old friend, Hot Shot allows Wheeljack to shoot him, but this isn't enough. Wheeljack takes Sideswipe hostage, but Hot Shot rescues him. On the moon, Megatron welcomes Wheeljack to the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron sacrifices Starscream, leaving him to face the Autobots alone while the Decepticons infiltrate the Autobot base to capture the Requiem Blaster. Smokescreen sacrifices himself to try to protect the Blaster minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hearing Megatron say he is nothing more than disposable cannon fodder, Starscream defects with the Star Sabre. To prove he's genuine, he gives the Autobots details of the moon base. Red Alert works on what's left of Smokescreen.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Starscream's help, the Autobots infiltrate the Decepticon moon base, attempting to rescue all the minicons Megatron has captured and forced into building a spaceship.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Alexis tracks a minicon in the vicinity of Mars. Starscream gets there first, but is disabled by Tidalwave. Jetfire rescues him: on the way back Starscream spots and tries to entice the minicon. But first they must get past Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the kids befriending and welcoming him, the Autobots deeply suspicious of him, and driven by his need to kill Megatron, the deeply conflicted Starscream trusts Thrust and returns to the moon base with the Star Sabre and Skyboom Shield.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Sabre, Shield and Blaster together create the Hydra Cannon. Installed on their new ship, the Decepticons test it on a comet - then Megatron orders Starscream to use it to destroy the Autobot base. Problem is, that'll also destroy the earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Optimus and Jetfire attack the ship, but can't stop the Hydra Cannon being deployed. Optimus makes the ultimate sacrifice and takes the full blast. Afterwards only his minicon and his matrix are found, but at least earth survives.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot insists they should take vengeance on the Decepticons: Scavenger, with the support of the minicons, reminds him of their true purpose. With Hot Shot's realisation of the right way forward, Jetfire hands over command to him.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the Autobot ship ready to leave, Hot Shot, supported by the rest of the team, refuse to let the children accompany them. But then the minicons refuse to allow the ship to depart unless the kids are on board.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: As the Axalon chases the Decepticon ship, hundreds of minicons appear. The 'Cons turn back to fight, and the 'Bots seem doomed, but the minicons resurrect Optimus.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot and Red Alert are sucked through a wormhole. The minicons guide the Axalon to their location, where they are all attacked by Nemesis Prime. As the planet breaks up, the 'Cons shoot down the Axalon and escape.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The 'Bots reach Cybertron to find Megatron (now calling himself Galvatron) already winning the war. The minicons fend off an attack by Unicron, warning of great danger, but Galvatron believes it just an Autobot trick.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: While the battle continues, Hot Shot goes to Cybertron to try to convince Galvatron of the impending danger. Thrust's true allegiance and agenda is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Thrust flees into the depths of Cybertron, pursued by Hot Shot and Wheeljack - and, separately, Starscream, who saves the children from being killed. The children discover the origins of the minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Thrust joins Sideways by passing through a portal deep underground: his pursuers follow and find themselves on Cybertron's moon, which begins to disintegrate. To everyone's horror, Unicron is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: To convince Galvatron he must ally with Optimus to prevent Unicron taking over the universe, Starscream makes the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues discussion with exes Michael and Susan, as well as Susan’s new husband, Cory, about the care of 11-year-old Bodhi, who Susan insists is experiencing schizophrenia, just like Michael and Susan’s 16-year-old daughter, Janni. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Second Schizophrenic Child Or A Misdiagnosing Mom: Can Bodhi Be Helped Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They threaten, scream, intimidate and even bite. They are not tantrum-throwing tots ... they are bullying dads!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Teens are obsessed with love more than ever. Parents are concerned over measures their daughters take to keep a boyfriend. A poll asked teens about extreme behavior, some saying they had sex when the didn't want to. Parents, don't miss these safety steps.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How did 21-year-old Jenna go from being a straight-A UC Berkeley student and former beauty queen to abusing heroin and meth and used as sexual currency in a drug house? Her mom is desperate to save her only child and turns to Dr. Phil for intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked about guests on Dr. Phil returns--Brandon! Plus, a desperate family turns to Dr. Phil to save their daughter who is addicted to OxyContin and heroin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you and your beloved say "I do," it's "for better or worse." But what happens when all you feel is the "worse" part and wind up trapped in a bad marriage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil digs into a heartbreaking story of a father's search for his missing daughter, then the loss of his grandchildren taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. Don't miss this chilling tale that spans three generations.
programme.sub-title: What The Children Remember: Was Mommy Murdered

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is the number one reason why couples say they get divorced. The country's current financial crisis has resulted in more couples getting buried in a landslide of debt which takes its toll on a marriage. Is your marriage on the rocks because of debt?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Logan, 30, desperately needs help. Mom Tracy says he has gone from a productive computer science engineer to a shell of a human being: no motivation, rarely eats, & can barely function to take care of his basic hygiene needs. Can Logan get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keith says his wife of 18 years, Sarah, is divorcing him and leaving their four children for "Kevin," a 26-year-old Kenyan pastor she met only on the internet. Dr. Phil sent a team to Kenya to investigate. You won’t want to miss what they discover!
programme.sub-title: My Wife Of 18 Years And Mother Of Our 4 Children Is Divorcing Me For A 26-Year-Old Kenyan Man She's Never Met

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marissa, 22, says her family treated her like an outcast in childhood & she later began working as an escort to make ends meet. Marissa faces family for the first time in 3 years on Dr. Phil's stage. Did they indeed reject her & is there hope for repair?
programme.sub-title: I Am The Outcast Of My Family And They Threw Me Away Like Trash!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shaela went from being a mom to two with a master's degree working as a school counselor to being unemployed & living in an RV. Mom Sandra says Shaela has exhibited strange behaviors, including trimming bushes & pulling weeds in the middle of the night.
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Went From Being A School Counselor With A Master's Degree To Losing Her Children & Living In An RV

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Angie & Hannah who say step-father & step-grandfather Ralph routinely sexually abused them. For the first time in 15 years, Angie & Hannah are face-to-face with Ralph, who denies all claims. Is Ralph cleared by a polygraph test?
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? The Polygraph Results Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil's guests say they are ready to run for the hills! Meet Kelly, who calls herself a runaway bride, and Chad, who says weddings are too expensive. Can Dr. Phil get them to commit?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shelby wants to find the truth about her dad's online relationship with a woman he's never met. Dad David says "Maria" has a $10 million inheritance and says he knows for a fact that "Maria" is a real person and he can't wait to introduce her one day.
programme.sub-title: My Dad Believes He's Married To A Woman Named "Maria" He's Never Met Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Facebook, unexpected things happen, like reuniting with a loved one or being fired after posting an inappropriate photograph. It can also be a lifesaver, offering a human connection when all seems lost. Dr. Phil delves into a story that made headlines.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A recent study shows that the number of men and women having extramarital affairs is on the rise. Could your spouse be cheating on you? Dr. Phil's guests are struggling with the aftermath of infidelity.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with pregnant teen, Sara, who says she’s not addicted--her sister is a bad influence. Dr. Phil learns she and sister Sadie did cocaine the night before the show. Dr. Phil shows video of addicted babies and issues an ultimatum. Part 2
programme.sub-title: Pregnant And Abusing Drugs: The Ultimatum Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brad says he is in a bitter custody battle with ex Kimberly, who's kept him from seeing their three kids. Kimberly says Brad is unstable & irresponsible and until he cleans up his act, he can't see their kids. Can these exes learn to peacefully co-parent?
programme.sub-title: My Ex Is Evil: I Want To See My Kids

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping two-part series, Dr. Phil sits down with a family torn apart over accusations of the unthinkable. Melody says her 4-year-old granddaughter revealed that she was touched inappropriately by a man in a mask, and that the man was her daddy.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: How will the islanders react when Caroline reveals who will be leaving the villa tonight after yesterday's public vote?

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Caroline Flack returns once more with eight potential new islanders in tow and hosts an audition to test how suited the newbies are to life in the villa.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: A catch-up on all the latest drama in the Love Island villa. Following an unforgettable fifth week, this show looks back at the events which have had everyone talking.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Newbies Katie and Adam J are settling in, but will their date choices leave the other islanders feeling uneasy? Katie and Sophie enjoy a successful date.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The islanders prepare themselves for a re-coupling, with Katie deliberating between Adam and Sophie. Terry is left in disbelief as he comes face-to-face with Malin.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: With Troy and Adam J's fate left in new girl Lauren's hands, who will she couple up with and who will be dumped? Katie is happy with picking Sophie and the day's challenge leaves some of the islanders questioning their places in the villa.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Katie confronts Sophie about their situation, leaving the other islanders to pick sides. Tina sides with Sophie, causing her to fall out with Adam as Lauren finds out where she stands with Adam J.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: With Sophie's departure leaving Katie single, will she be able to couple up or has her time in the villa come to an end? The boys undergo a lie detector test.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Caroline arrives at the villa with a shock announcement. The islanders become parents for the day. Nathan and Cara enjoy one final date.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: With the finish line in sight, the islanders have been up to all sorts to get your attention, and this highlights show rounds up all the hottest action from the past week.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: With the finale tomorrow, the prize fund has never seemed closer, but who can be trusted when there is so much at stake? Is it all about the money, or will romance win out?

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Tonight the viewers choose their favourite couple. Who do you think deserves the 50,000 pound prize money? Join in the fun with Caroline Flack and have your say.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The nation's favourite villa throws open its doors as Caroline Flack reveals the gorgeous singles who will be making up the class of 2018. Of course, telling us exactly what he thinks is the voice of 'Love Island', Scotland's finest, Iain Stirling.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The cast of hot young singles get used to life in paradise and the daily routine of dating, flirting and gossiping to their heart's content. The games have already begun, and the Islanders are learning that in paradise nothing is quite what it seems.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The young singles are settling into their summer of love and romance. There is no let up in the surprises the new islanders must face to win the cash prize and one thing is for sure, while the sun keeps shining, nobody wants to leave paradise.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Georgia's date with Niall goes well, and they kiss. Rosie and Alex's date is a bit stilted. Eyal and Hayley have a row, ending their relationship.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: As the first week comes to a close, 2018's islanders are learning that staying in paradise is easier said than done. They arrived looking for romance and fun in the sun, but with £50,000 to win it is possible romance will not be able to compete.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff dies while chasing a car carrying two SEALs in a Navy exercise. The driver stands trial for negligent homicide. Bud goes home, the new SecNav takes office, and Harm takes Meredith for a thrilling flight.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A Radar Intercept Officer dies of hypoxia, traced to contaminated oxygen. Mac prosecutes the PO apparently at fault; Harm makes a poor defense and Sturgis takes over. Harm learns the truth eventually. Bud resents Harriet's protectiveness.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: As a favor from Congresswoman Lillian Dorning, SECNAV Sheffield asks the JAG staff to get the story of a submarine, USS Angel Shark (SSGN-559), which was lost on a CIA mission in 1968.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A Navy pilot drops a bomb on a British position, killing three soldiers and injuring others. In a court-martial he faces charges of involuntary homicide and dereliction of duty. Mac and Bud prosecute, Sturgis defends, and Harm presides.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A Marine faces a charge of dereliction after becoming lost in Iraq in a sandstorm; Sturgis prosecutes, and Mac defends. Harm flies again for the CIA, aboard a spy plane for a training hop, which turns into a real mission over North Korea.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A Marine helo gunship intervenes during a standoff at a ranch; Mac prosecutes the pilot, and Harm defends. Bud investigates a Naval Reserve physician who, a conscientious objector, has received his medical education at Navy expense.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Mac must defend a petty officer accused of murdering a female officer, but the man has no memory of the night in question, while a Navy SEAL who purchased nerve gas needs Bud's help to avoid prison.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: MGen. Creswell has taken charge. An official of the DoD has died in Iraq; a Marine staff sergeant goes on trial for involuntary manslaughter by culpable negligence; Harm prosecutes, and Mac defends. Officers take partial responsibility.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Harm and Mac find themselves on opposing sides when a Navy psychiatrist is charged with allegedly sending a marine diagnosed with combat stress back to battle too soon.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A sailor dies during a fight aboard a ship at sea; Bud discovers the explanation. Mattie wakes up and talks. The general announces a reorganization, orders, and a promotion.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A woman radar-intercept officer (RIO) disappears at night from an aircraft carrier in the Adriatic Sea. Two JAG lawyers, Lt. Harm Rabb and Lt. Caitlin Pike, investigate and solve. Harm, a former Naval aviator, unexpectedly becomes a hero.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A civilian tech rep aboard a submarine seizes control of an experimental torpedo after its launch during an exercise

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Due to a human error in an exercise, artillery fire injures seven Marines, one of whom later dies.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Three Navy lieutenants die by homicide in 11 months around Washington. Harm and Meg investigate

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Two Naval aviators die in a crash of an F-14 while using a new fly-by-wire navigation system.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: In Lima, Peru, while a boy sneaks into the US embassy at night, a Marine guard stops him.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A sailor has stolen two Stinger missiles from a base. Harm and Meg investigate.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Two Marines in a Humvee mistakenly drive into Iraq; an Iraqi detail intercepts them, kills one, and captures the other.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The team attempts to locate Mosley after she murders a cartel hit man and goes off the grid.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The NCIS team partners with the State Department after the murder of an arms dealer is connected to a series of crimes seemingly executed by someone with elite special forces training.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Deputy Director Ochoa volunteers the NCIS team to assist with a covert operation tied to a terrorist group advocating for extreme military force.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The NCIS team investigates the home invasion of Navy Captain Dean Hadlow, who was entertaining his friend, General Omer Abidi of Pakistan, when robbers successfully stole money, jewelry and highly classified information.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: An elaborate bank heist to steal a single safe deposit box held by Veronica Stephens, a Navy contractor, leads NCIS to investigate her corrupt consulting firm.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The NCIS team is joined by NCIS Special Agent Nicole DeChamps after a Marine reservist with a history of PTSD disappears following a drunk and disorderly altercation.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The chief of logistics for a naval weapons station collapses on the job, and the NCIS team must determine if it's a terror threat or a stress-induced breakdown.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The team works with the Global Criminal Tribunal when a Syrian is attacked while delivering evidence that would prove chemical weapons were used on civilians

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The NCIS team partners with the FBI to locate a terrorist cell in Los Angeles believed to be preparing for an imminent attack.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The team continues to search for a terrorist cell in Los Angeles; Callen and Sam remain trapped in a movie theater after multiple bombs have detonated, and every remaining exit is wired with explosives.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a journalist who was writing an exposé on a mishandled classified military operation

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After months of planning, the NCIS family celebrates the wedding of Kensi and Deeks; an old acquaintance pays Deeks a surprise visit on his wedding day.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Sydney turns to her sister Nell for help after her high school crush gets mixed up in a Russian plot to steal intelligence from the Department of Defense

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Department of Justice Agent Lance Hamilton asks Sam for assistance in locating a former U.S. Border Patrol tactical officer who disappeared following a threat by the cartel.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony accompanies world-renowned chef and restaurateur Daniel Boulud as they travel back to Daniel’s hometown of Lyon, France for a pilgrimage of the city’s rich food culture and its legendary chefs.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony explores a few of the many faces of Miami. Chef Michelle Bernstein takes Tony out to an authentic Cuban breakfast and a late-night dinner at a gas station café in Doral.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony heads back to his much-beloved Salvador, Brazil. The ever-present street festivals and the famous Carnival parade begin with sitting down with a local artist in the streets of the historic Pelo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony visits Andalucia during Semana Santa – Holy Week – a time filled with great pageantry and excitement. Tony’s longtime DP, Zach Zamboni, currently lives in Granada with his fiancée, Fuen Sanchez.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown, we first visit the city of Glasgow, then we head north into the Scottish Highlands.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: For the first time, Tony visits Budapest, 25 years after democracy planted its flag –alongside the Oscar-winning master of light, cinematographer Vilmos Zsigmond, as one of his key guides.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: A country of only six million people where a vast percentage of the land is steaming hot jungle or a huge scrub desert known simply as The Chaco. This is one of the least known nations in the world.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony seeks to challenge his notions of Mississippi by taking a road trip to meet a cast of Mississippians enjoying the diverse foodways and embracing the traditional and contemporary music worlds.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: New Mexico has the largest Hispanic population per capita in the US. No better way to see the mash-up of cultures that make up this uniquely American State, than by what the people here are eating

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Mexico City and Oaxaca to meet who fight for the food, the art, and the lives they believe in. In the Santa Anita neighbourhood of Mexico City, Tony meets boxer Jorge Lacierva.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
